spec.name: Furniture Bat Bench
spec.description: A sturdy two-seat gothic garden bench with purple cushions, blackened oak framing and a stepped bat-wing backrest. Cushion tops sit at y=14; the low ornamental back reaches y=16. All parts are axis-aligned, physically connected and contained within the requested footprint.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: two-seat gothic garden bench with a dark bat-wing shaped backrest, purple seat cushions and sturdy black wood legs. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..32, y=0..16, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges. Seat cushion top must be at y=14 so a player can sit on it. Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
